name: CES 209 TCAS机动 备降/返航

cards.audioText: Your call sign is CES 209, you are in Shanghai Control area, you are maintaining 8400 meters, make an initial contact with Shanghai Control.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是 CES 209，你位于上海管制区，正保持 8400 米，与上海管制首次联系。
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海管制，CES 209，正保持 8400 米。

cards.audioText: CES 209, Shanghai Control, radar contact, climb to 10,400 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 209，上海管制，雷达识别，爬升至 10,400 米。

cards.audioText: now you are cruising at 10,400 meters, your instruments indicate left pack has malfunctioned, contact Shanghai Control and request descend to lower levels.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你正以 10,400 米巡航，仪表显示左组件故障，联系上海管制并请求下降至较低高度。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Control, CES 209, maintaining 10,400 meters, our instruments indicate our left pack has malfunctioned, request descent to lower levels.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海管制，CES 209，正保持 10,400 米，我们的仪表显示左组件故障，请求下降至较低高度。

cards.audioText: CES 209, turn right heading 240, descend to 8900 meters initially.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 209，右转航向 240，先下降至 8900 米。
cards.referenceText: turn right heading 240, descend to 8,900 meters initially, CES 209.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 240，先下降至 8,900 米，CES 209。

cards.audioText: During descent, your right pack is overheating and both packs have malfunctioned, and request emergency descent. This is a distress call.
cards.audioTextZh: 下降期间，右组件过热且两个组件均发生故障，请求紧急下降。这是遇险呼叫。
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY, Shanghai Control, CES 209, our right pack is overheating and both packs have malfunctioned, request emergency descent.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY，MAYDAY，MAYDAY，上海管制，CES 209，我们的右组件过热且两个组件均发生故障，请求紧急下降。

cards.audioText: During descent, your cabin altitude is rising rapidly, request emergency descent to 3000 meters, this is a distress call.
cards.audioTextZh: 下降期间，你的客舱高度迅速升高，请求紧急下降至 3000 米，这是遇险呼叫。
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY, Shanghai Control, CES 209, request emergency descent to 3000 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY，MAYDAY，MAYDAY，上海管制，CES 209，请求紧急下降至 3000 米。

cards.audioText: CES 209, descend to 3000 meters on QNH 1031.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 209，在 QNH 1031 上下降至 3000 米。
cards.referenceText: descend to 3000 meters on QNH 1031, CES 209
cards.referenceTextZh: 在 QNH 1031 上下降至 3000 米，CES 209。

cards.audioText: Now you are maintaining 3000 meters, cabin altitude has resumed to normal, you will cancel distress, report it to Shanghai Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你正保持 3000 米，客舱高度已恢复正常，你将取消遇险状态，向上海进近报告。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Approach, CES 209, maintaining 3000 meters, the cabin altitude has resumed to normal, cancel distress.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海进近，CES 209，正保持 3000 米，客舱高度已恢复正常，取消遇险状态。

cards.audioText: the cabin crew reports 5 passengers in the cabin are (seriously) injured during emergency descent, inform the situation to Shanghai Control, and request divert to Hangzhou.
cards.audioTextZh: 客舱机组报告，在紧急下降期间客舱内有 5 名乘客（严重）受伤，向上海管制通报情况并请求备降杭州。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Control, CES 209, five passengers are seriously injured, request divert to Hangzhou.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海管制，CES 209，五名乘客严重受伤，请求备降杭州。

cards.audioText:
C: CES 209, divert to Hangzhou approved, what assistance do you need?
B: Tell the controller you need ambulances on arrival.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： CES 209，批准备降杭州，你需要什么协助？
B： 告诉管制员你需要在到达时安排救护车。
cards.referenceText: divert to Hangzhou approved, request ambulances on arrival, CES 209.
cards.referenceTextZh: 批准备降杭州，请求在到达时安排救护车，CES 209。

cards.audioText: CES 209, ambulances will be ready upon arrival.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 209，救护车将在到达时就位。

cards.audioText: CES 209, turn right heading 180, descend and maintain 2,100 meters, QNH 1031, expect ILS approach Runway 06.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 209，右转航向 180，下降并保持 2,100 米，QNH 1031，预计 ILS 进近 Runway 06。
cards.referenceText: turn right heading 180, descend and maintain 2100 meters, QNH 1031, expect ILS approach Runway 06, CES 209.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 180，下降并保持 2100 米，QNH 1031，预计 ILS 进近 Runway 06，CES 209。

cards.audioText: now tell Hangzhou tower about your situation and request priority landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在向杭州塔台说明你的情况并请求优先落地。
cards.referenceText: Hangzhou Tower, CES 209, five passengers were seriously injured during emergency descent, request priority landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 杭州塔台，CES 209，五名乘客在紧急下降期间严重受伤，请求优先落地。

cards.audioText: CES 209, straight in ILS approach Runway 06, report established.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 209，直线 ILS 进近 Runway 06，建立后报告。
cards.referenceText: straight in ILS approach Runway 06, CES 209.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直线 ILS 进近 Runway 06，CES 209。

cards.audioText: Now you have established on ILS approach Runway 06.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已建立 ILS 进近 Runway 06。
cards.referenceText: Hangzhou Tower, CES 209, established ILS approach Runway 06.
cards.referenceTextZh: 杭州塔台，CES 209，已建立 ILS 进近 Runway 06。
